eden-courtyard.blurb: A pure-vegetarian restaurant on the 3rd floor of Mani Square Mall, Kankurgachi, with a broad Asian, Italian and modern-Indian menu.

tips.expect: A well-liked vegetarian dining room that suits families and groups. About ₹1,500 for two.
tips.good: The creative veg menu and the ambience, which many reviewers rate highly.
tips.watch: It is inside a mall, so it is better for a sit-down meal than a quick bite between pandals.
tips.tip: Handy before or after the Maniktala and Phoolbagan pandals.

25-main-street-cafe.blurb: A popular Salt Lake Sector 1 cafe at AA28, known for coffee, desserts and a good breakfast menu with sourdough.

tips.expect: A relaxed all-day cafe with a long menu: pizza, pasta, sandwiches and a bit of Korean. About ₹1,000 for two.
tips.good: Coffee and desserts, and a strong breakfast. It is very well rated.
tips.watch: It's busy at weekends and often has a wait.
tips.tip: A good coffee stop in the Salt Lake blocks cluster (AE, AB, BJ, CE).

dulcie-dubai.blurb: A small dessert cafe on Hindustan Road, Ballygunge, known for Middle Eastern-style sweets.

tips.expect: An inexpensive dessert-and-coffee stop. About ₹400 for two, and rated 4.7.
tips.good: The unusual Middle Eastern-style desserts at a low price.
tips.watch: It's tiny, so seats can be hard to find in the evening.
tips.tip: Next door to Amar Khamar on Hindustan Road. A natural sweet finish after dinner.

casa-miami-by-pepper-town.blurb: A beach-themed restaurant in New Town from the Pepper Town group.

tips.expect: A Miami beach look with Asian, Chinese and Italian dishes. About ₹1,000 for two, with veg and non-veg options.
tips.watch: It is far out in New Town, away from every pandal circuit on your list.
tips.tip: Only worth it if you are already in New Town or Rajarhat.

cove-community-bar.blurb: A high-energy bar and restaurant in the historic Harrington Mansion on Ho Chi Minh Sarani, with cave-inspired interiors by Akash Roy.

tips.expect: A modern hideout that shifts from a relaxed evening to a nightlife mood. About ₹2,000 for two.
tips.good: The dark, sculptural interior and the mixed Italian, North Indian and Asian menu.
tips.watch: It gets loud later in the evening.
tips.tip: A solid late-night stop close to Park Street.

altair-capella.blurb: A rooftop restaurant and microbrewery on the 20th and 21st floors of AltAir Boutique Hotel, Sector V, with 360-degree views of the city.

tips.expect: A sky bar with city-skyline views, cocktails and a multicuisine menu. About ₹1,600 for two.
tips.good: The view, which is excellent at night over Salt Lake.
tips.watch: It is high up in an office building: allow time for the lifts and book ahead on weekends.
tips.tip: A strong date-night finish after the Salt Lake pandals.
